name: labee-protocol-searcher
description: Search selected laboratory-protocol publishers through the hosted MCP service, with per-source toggles and safe browser-assisted retrieval.

interface.longDescription: Choose publishers, suppliers, and REBASE with individual skill toggles, then search only the enabled sources through the hosted Labee service. The plugin connects directly to Labee over authenticated HTTPS, without downloading an npm package at startup. NEB capture uses Codex's integrated Browser; explicitly authorized journal fallback can reuse a connected Chrome session without exposing cookies.
defaultPrompt: Find an NEB protocol and retrieve it with Codex's integrated Browser.
Search my enabled publishers for an open full-text method.
Fetch a journal article, reusing my connected Chrome session only if native retrieval fails.
